titleEnglish: The Raising of the Black Stone

verses.ar: وَلَمَّا بَلَغَ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ تَعَالَى عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ خَمْسًا وَثَلَاثِينَ سَنَةً بَنَتْ قُرَيْشٌ الْكَعْبَةَ لِانْصِدَاعِهَا بِالسُّيُولِ الْأَبْطَحِيَّةْ ۞ وَتَنَازَعُوا فِي رَفْعِ الْحَجَرِ الْأَسْوَدِ فَكُلٌّ أَرَادَ رَفْعَهُ وَرَجَاهْ ۞ وَعَظُمَ الْقِيلُ وَالْقَالُ وَتَحَالَفُوا عَلٰى الْقِتَالِ وَقَوِيَتِ الْعَصَبِيَّةْ
verses.tr: Wa-lammā balagha ṣalla Llāhu taʿālā ʿalayhi wa-sallama khamsan wa-thalāthīna sanatan banat Qurayshun l-kaʿbata li-n-ṣidāʿihā bi-s-suyūli l-abṭaḥiyyah, wa-tanāzaʿū fī rafʿi l-ḥajari l-aswadi fa-kullun arāda rafʿahu wa-rajāh, wa-ʿaẓuma l-qīlu wa-l-qālu wa-taḥālafū ʿalā l-qitāli wa-qawiyati l-ʿaṣabiyyah.
verses.en: When he, may Allah Most High send prayers and peace upon him, reached thirty-five years of age, Quraysh rebuilt the Ka'bah after it had been damaged by the floods of al-Abtah. They disputed over the raising of the Black Stone, each group desiring and hoping to have the honour of raising it. The dispute and contention grew intense, and they pledged themselves to fight as tribal rivalry became ever stronger.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ تَدَاعُوا إِلَى الْإِنْصَافِ وَفَوَّضُوا الْأَمْرَ إِلَى ذِي رَأْيٍ صَائِبٍ وَأَنَاةْ ۞ فَحَكَمَ بِتَحْكِيمِ أَوَّلِ دَاخِلٍ مِنْ بَابِ السَّدَنَةِ الشَّيْبِيَّةْ ۞ فَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ تَعَالَى عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَوَّلَ دَاخِلٍ فَقَالُوا: هَذَا الْأَمِينُ وَكُلُّنَا نَقْبَلُهُ وَنَرْضَاهْ ۞ فَأَخْبَرُوهُ بِأَنَّهُمْ رَضُوهُ أَنْ يَكُونَ صَاحِبَ الْحُكْمِ فِي هَذَا الْمُلِمِّ وَوَلِيَّهْ
verses.tr: Thumma tadāʿū ilā l-inṣāfi wa-fawwaḍū l-amra ilā dhī ra'yin ṣā'ibin wa-anāh, fa-ḥakama bi-taḥkīmi awwali dākhilin min bābi s-sadanati sh-Shaybiyyah, fa-kāna n-nabiyyu ṣalla Llāhu taʿālā ʿalayhi wa-sallama awwala dākhilin fa-qālū: hādhā l-amīnu wa-kullunā naqbaluhu wa-narḍāh, fa-akhbarūhu bi-annahum raḍūhu an yakūna ṣāḥiba l-ḥukmi fī hādhā l-mulimmi wa-waliyyah.
verses.en: Then they called one another to fairness and entrusted the matter to a man of sound judgement and deliberation, who ruled that the first person to enter through the gate of the Banu Shaybah should be appointed as arbiter. The Prophet, may Allah Most High send prayers and peace upon him, was the first to enter, so they said, “This is al-Amin, the Trustworthy One, and we all accept him and are pleased with him.” They then informed him that they had agreed to accept him as the judge and the one entrusted with resolving this difficult matter.

verses.ar: فَوَضَعَ الْحَجَرَ فِي ثَوْبٍ ثُمَّ أَمَرَ أَنْ تَرْفَعَهُ الْقَبَائِلُ جَمِيعًا إِلَى مُرْتَقَاهْ ۞ فَرَفَعُوهُ إِلَى مَقَرِّهِ مِنْ رُكْنِ هَاتِيكَ الْبَنِيَّةْ ۞ وَوَضَعَهُ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ تَعَالَى عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِيَدِهِ الشَّرِيفَةِ فِي مَوْضِعِهِ الْآنَ وَبَنَاهْ
verses.tr: Fa-waḍaʿa l-ḥajara fī thawbin thumma amara an tarfaʿahu l-qabā'ilu jamīʿan ilā murtaqāh, fa-rafaʿūhu ilā maqarrihi min rukni hātīka l-baniyyah, wa-waḍaʿahu ṣalla Llāhu taʿālā ʿalayhi wa-sallama bi-yadihi sh-sharīfati fī mawḍiʿihi l-āna wa-banāh.
verses.en: He placed the Black Stone in a cloth, then instructed all the tribes to raise it together to its appointed height. They raised it to its place in the corner of that Sacred House, and he, may Allah Most High send prayers and peace upon him, placed it with his noble hand in the position where it remains today and set it firmly in place.

verses.ar:
عَطِّرِ اللّٰهُمَّ قَبْرَهُ الْكَرِيمَ بِعَرْفٍ شَذِيٍّ مِنْ صَلَاةٍ وَتَسْلِيمٍ
اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ
verses.tr:
ʿAṭṭiri Llāhumma qabrahu l-karīma bi-ʿarfin shadhiyyin min ṣalātin wa-taslīmin.
Allāhumma ṣalli wa-sallim wa-bārik ʿalayhi.
verses.en:
O Allah, perfume his noble grave with a fragrant scent of prayers and peace.
O Allah, send prayers, peace, and blessings upon him.
